edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the dispute between them that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”). The “Effective Date” means the date on which the last party signs this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] within 10 days after the Effective Date, by wire transfer pursuant to instructions separately confirmed by Plaintiff’s counsel.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full settlement payment in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising from the Dispute. This release does not extend to claims unrelated to the Dispute or to rights or obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that disclosures may be made to their legal and tax advisers, as required by law, or as necessary to enforce this Agreement.
